title: The dressing layer is STRUCTURAL ART routed through the decoration channel, and that is why nothing checks it
remainder: The intrusion contract: "`allowed_inward_intrusion_m` in the slot manifest and a gate that reads it" (body; 2026-08-18 status: "zero occurrences in code or in any manifest. Nothing has been built")

The reclassification / routing: dressing "is still structural art on the layer-3 props channel: no slot, no placement gate, no collision authority, no intrusion limit" -- "real work that wants a decision before code"
The panel-field material question -- which the 2026-08-18 status already calls "now moot on this evidence, because the panel fields are gone"

per_piece.piece: Intrusion contract: allowed_inward_intrusion_m in the slot manifest plus a gate that reads it
per_piece.evidence: `git grep -E 'allowed_inward_intrusion|inward_intrusion'` returns nothing in any of the nine tool repos (lot, level_factory, deli_counter, zoo, lux, patina, pixelcoat, dispatch, lasertag). The nearest thing is Patina's `openings.room_boxes` (patina/patina/openings.py:215-263): room bounds inset by half the wall plus `_PROUDEST_COVER` 0.10 m, so only what sticks into a room is flagged -- an inward-intrusion keep-out in all but name. It was added 2026-08-03 (8d468c8) and has NO caller: `git grep room_boxes` finds only its definition and a docstring mention (patina/slots.py:412). patina/cli.py:467-489 enforces only `openings.keep_out_boxes` (openings) and `gp_keepout.keep_out_boxes` (gameplay markers). Cost seen since: roadmap 221 (CLOSED 2026-10-10) -- 28 base courses and 52 curbs stood inside strip_club_a01's walls through every gate and were found by reading orders, not by a gate (Patina 0.30.0, 31d31e9).
per_piece.checked: git grep in each tool repo (the root .gitignore excludes the tool repos, so a root-level search cannot see them); read patina/openings.py:1-413 and patina/cli.py:425-500; git log -S room_boxes

per_piece.piece: Reclassification: route the structural-art families through slots with a placement/fit gate and collision authority (a design decision first)
per_piece.evidence: Partly moved, not decided. Slot-driven now: gutters, downspouts, Empties' window bars/AC units, lintels/sills, security doors, antennas/dishes all iterate `manifest.slots` (patina/patina/framing.py:150, 200, 250, 346, 436-461, 544; Patina 0.25.0-0.29.1, 2026-10-04/05). Still geometry-driven: base course, curb, edge strip and conduit come from `anchors._wall_segments(scene)` (patina/patina/anchors.py:124, 449), with no slot. The only gate reading the dressing layer is Deli Counter's circulation gate (deli_counter/circulation.py:1-50, `check_dressing`; dressing must keep ladders, doorways and stair columns clear), dating from 2026-07-25 (a2fc6235), filed by Level Factory as PRESENTATION_CIRCULATION, moderate, `blocking: False` (level_factory/adapters/presentation/__init__.py:642-659). No fit gate on dressing like PRESENTATION_PLACEMENT_MISMATCH (that one checks themed slot modules only, :580-602). No recorded decision on the reclassification found in the roadmap (grep 'structural art|props channel|decoration channel' hits only this item and item 44's cross-reference at line 5239).
per_piece.checked: read patina framing.py/anchors.py function lists and slot loops; read level_factory adapters/presentation/__init__.py:535-668; read deli_counter/circulation.py:1-90 and its git log; grep of the roadmap

per_piece.evidence: Level Factory stopped asking Patina for panel fields and pilasters on 2026-08-04 (d6b816b): level_factory/adapters/patina/__init__.py:159-183 -- `args += ["--dressing", "--anchors", "--gutters"]`, with the comment that wall articulation moved into the module (`arch.relief_parts`). Already called moot in the item's own 2026-08-18 status.
per_piece.checked: read the adapter; git log -S 'pilasters are gone' in level_factory

done_since: Patina 0.25.0-0.29.1 (2026-10-04/05) orders gutters/downspouts and the Empties' fixtures (window bars, AC units, lintels, sills, security doors, antennas, dishes) from Deli Counter slot fields -- structural art routed through slots for those families (patina/patina/framing.py:150-461).

The full reclassification still wants the design decision the item asks for. Roadmap item 44 (body, line 5239: "Item 41 is the same boundary from the other side ... both want `allowed_inward_intrusion_m` in the slot manifest with something that reads it") cites the same missing contract, so doing it would serve both items.
